pages.title: Dark Walker
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r I$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r Boots$(br2)§lEffect:§r Wardens quickly forget you and cannot lock onto you, and their attacks cannot hurt you. However, sculk sensors and shriekers can still be triggered by vibrations.$(br2)§lConflicts:§r Swift Sneak$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Enchanting table, ancient city chests
